one_line: Finished result first, the pack's front shown at 0:02, then a time-compressed top-down fold to a hanging display.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 holographic paper cranes clipped to a green string on a wooden table among red glitter pomegranate cut-outs. 0:01 the camera drifts and a pack appears; 0:02 its front, "אוריגמי חיות" and "15". No speech, no text over the picture.
q1_hook.why: A shiny finished result fills the first frame and the product is on screen by 0:01 and legible at 0:02 (H1, S1, H2). The pack text carries the claim, the only words. But no spoken or written line says what it is, so the hook is image only (H6, T3).

beats.what: Holographic cranes on a string; the pack's front, "אוריגמי חיות", "15"
Holographic sheets pulled out, the first fold begun
Hands fold the sheet, an instruction sheet behind
beats.why: Steps shown, a new fold every second

beats.what: Hands open the folded paper into a crane; shimmer shows on each turn
beats.why: The paper's shine is the visual reward

beats.what: The finished crane on the table; a clothespin clips it to the string
Cranes hang on the string in front of a curtain, close and low

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption makes statements only ("חג שמח ונוצץ"): no question, comment word, save, send or tag ask.
q2_flow.why: The result seen first raises "how" and the crane at 0:18 answers it (H5, R4). The shine changes every second, which holds the middle (R3). The folding looks time-compressed, so no dead air (R1). 26 s suits one craft (R2). The last 4 s are a quiet hold with no new information.

q3_cta.what: None in the video, none in the caption. The caption is a greeting and a description: "חג שמח ונוצץ ✨️", "ערכות יצירה להכנת מגוון חיות אוריגמי מניירות הולוגרפיים לקישוט הסוכה ובכלל !". No link, price or where to buy.
q3_cta.why: No ask keeps the sell very light (C7, C1). The cost is that a viewer who wants the kit has no brand name in the caption, only on the pack for 1 s, and no save, send or comment prompt for a holiday craft (R7, C4).

q4_shown.what: Finished cranes on a string 0:00 to 0:02; the pack, with Palphot's logo and "15", 0:01 to 0:03; adult hands pulling out holographic sheets and folding, 0:03 to 0:18; the finished crane, a clothespin, then hanging cranes to 0:26. No face, no child, no price.
q4_shown.why: The product, the sheets, is handled at 0:03 and the pack is in frame at 0:01 (S1). The brand shows only on the pack for about 2 s, a very light pulse (H3, C7). Hands only carry it (S4). The result is the proof, and no child is shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: 5 shots in 25.7 s, about 5 s each; cuts at 3.1, 6.1, 8.2 and 21.6 s, a 13 s middle shot from 0:08 to 0:21. The folding is time-compressed (a full crane in about 14 s). No text, no speech. Ends on hanging cranes.
q5_edit.why: The camera moves in the first second (E1). Compressing the fold removes dead time (E3, R1). Few cuts and 5 to 13 s shots are slower than the advised 2 to 5 s (E2). With no voice or text, a muted viewer gets no message (E4).

q6_topic.what: Folding holographic paper cranes from a kit to decorate a Sukkah; serves a parent or teacher who wants a festive craft.
q6_topic.why: A named holiday and a decoration to hang answer a real seasonal need (K7). It is calm and festive, not high arousal (K1). The shiny result is the feeling here, and a holiday craft is easy to save or send (R5). The caption says "ובכלל", widening the use.

q7_filmed.what: Phone handheld above a wooden table in warm daylight, adult hands only; a close drift to the pack; a medium to close view of the fold; a low, close, backlit view of the cranes on the string in front of a curtain.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the maker's seat (F5), and the shine fills the frame (F4). It is live, warm and homemade (F8, F7). The last shot is dim and backlit, which dulls the shimmer, the Reel's selling point (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: None: no headline, no subtitles, no labels, no CTA. The only Hebrew is printed on the pack: "אוריגמי חיות", "מקפלים מגוון חיות אוריגמי מניירות הולוגרפיים", "15" and the Palphot logo, on screen about 0:01 to 0:03.
q8_text.caption: "חג שמח ונוצץ ✨️". 16 words in 3 short lines: a holiday greeting and a plain description of the kit, with the use "לקישוט הסוכה ובכלל". No hashtags, no brand tag, no question, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: With no overlay text and no voice, the Reel states neither the kit nor the holiday on its own, so only the pack text carries a message (T1, T3). The caption has product and occasion keywords but no hashtags and no brand name (T7). Palphot is a co-author, with no partnership wording (T8).

weak_points: No voice, text or ask; the brand named only on the pack for about 2 s and not in the caption; a dim, backlit last shot; no hashtags; no partnership wording; 4 s of hold at the end.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on the finished object, show the box front at 0:02, fold or flip top-down with hands only, and end on a bright shot of the result.
not_verified: Music (transcript only "תודה רבה"). Whether the fold is sped up (it looks compressed, a full crane in about 14 s). The age range and price of the kit. Who the creator is. No corrections to the coded file.
